title: Neopixel
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Neopixel
learningObjectives: Explain how a NeoPixel receives a serial data stream in which each packet carries three 0-255 values for the red, green, and blue channels
Trace how the first packet is pulled off the data line at each pixel while the remaining packets continue on to downstream pixels
Predict the resulting color of the NeoPixel when a packet with given red, green, and blue values arrives
Use the start, step, stop, and reset buttons to single-step the data stream and observe one packet transfer at a time
